name: Airport Transfer
summary: Flat-rate private car service between your door and the terminal, with flight tracking and meet-and-greet pickup.
features: Live flight tracking, so pickup moves with delays
Meet-and-greet at baggage claim with a name sign
Flat rate quoted upfront, tolls and fees included

faqs.q: What happens if my flight is delayed?
faqs.a: We track your flight number and adjust the pickup time automatically. You are not charged for airline delays.

faqs.q: Where will the driver meet me?
faqs.a: For meet-and-greet bookings the chauffeur waits at baggage claim with a name sign. For curbside pickups you receive the driver's number and vehicle details by text.

faqs.q: Is the price per person or per vehicle?
faqs.a: Per vehicle. The quote covers everyone in your party up to the vehicle's seating capacity.

name: Corporate Car Service
summary: Executive sedans and SUVs for meetings, roadshows and client pickups, billed to one company account.
features: Monthly invoicing on a single company account
Hourly as-directed bookings for multi-stop days
Wi-Fi and chargers in every vehicle

faqs.q: Can several employees book on one account?
faqs.a: Yes. Each traveller books under the company account and every ride appears on one monthly invoice with cost-centre references.
Yes. As-directed bookings keep the car and chauffeur with you for a set number of hours, which suits roadshows and multi-stop days.

name: Wedding Limo
summary: Decorated stretch limousines and luxury sedans for the couple, the wedding party and guest shuttles.
features: Red carpet and ribbon decoration included
Packages for ceremony, photos and reception
Complimentary chilled water and champagne flutes

faqs.q: How far ahead should we book?
faqs.a: Weekend dates in peak season book out early, so reserve as soon as your venues are confirmed. A deposit holds the vehicle and date.
Yes. Wedding packages are hourly, so the chauffeur follows your schedule between ceremony, photo locations and reception.
